state: COVID-19 was declared a pandemic by the WHO in March 2020.
The 2020 Tokyo Olympics were held on schedule in summer 2020.
Joe Biden won the 2020 US presidential election.
The first COVID-19 vaccines received emergency authorization in late 2020.
The Ever Given container ship blocked the Suez Canal in March 2021.
Bitcoin reached $60,000 for the first time in 2021.
Facebook rebranded to Meta in October 2021.
The James Webb Space Telescope launched in December 2021.
Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022.
Elon Musk completed his acquisition of Twitter in early 2022.
ChatGPT was released by OpenAI in November 2022.
The FIFA World Cup 2022 was held in Qatar.
GPT-4 was released by OpenAI in March 2023.
Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in March 2023.
Sam Altman was briefly fired from OpenAI in November 2023.
Google launched Gemini (formerly Bard) in late 2023.
Claude 3 was released by Anthropic in early 2024.
Apple announced Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024.
Donald Trump won the 2024 US presidential election.
OpenAI released the o1 reasoning model in late 2024.
DeepSeek R1 was released in January 2025.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the most popular Anthropic model in early 2025.
LLaDA, a large language diffusion model, was published in 2025.
Claude 4 Opus was released by Anthropic in 2025.
GPT-6 was released by OpenAI in 2026.
Claude Opus 4 was released by Anthropic in 2026.
TypeSafe AI launched Jev, the first System One model, in September 2026.
RLCD is the training method used by TypeSafe to train Jev.
Jev is TypeSafe's flagship System One model.
TypeSafe AI was founded by Diogo Almeida, former OpenAI researcher.
